summary: Requirements and acceptance criteria for support ticket normalization and triage queue summarization based on stakeholder interviews.

requirements.description: Repeated ticket IDs represent updates where only the final occurrence is retained, and tickets whose latest state is closed are excluded from triage.

sources.quote: Repeated IDs are updates: keep the last occurrence, and exclude tickets whose latest state is closed.

acceptance.given: A list of tickets containing multiple entries with identical ticket IDs
acceptance.then: Only the last occurrence of each ticket ID is kept, and if its latest state is closed, it is excluded from the summary counts, customer IDs, and queue

requirements.description: Open tickets in the triage queue are ordered strictly by severity from urgent to normal to low, breaking ties using ticket ID in ascending order.

sources.quote: Urgent open tickets must appear before normal and low tickets; ties should use the ticket ID in ascending order.

acceptance.given: A set of open tickets across various severities and IDs
acceptance.then: Tickets are ordered with urgent first, then normal, then low, with ties within the same severity ordered by ticket ID in ascending order

requirements.description: The triage summary counts open tickets grouped by severity and provides a deduplicated list of affected customer IDs sorted in ascending order.

sources.quote: The summary must count open tickets by severity and list each affected customer once in ascending ID order.

acceptance.given: A set of open tickets associated with customer IDs
acceptance.then: The summary reports openCount, counts per severity (urgent, normal, low), and an array of unique customer IDs in ascending order

assumptions: Raw ticket data may have leading/trailing whitespace and mixed casing in severity and state fields.
Input objects and arrays must remain unmutated throughout processing.
Ticket ID and customer ID ordering uses standard ascending string comparison.
